wiki.title: Khanh Pham
wiki.extract: Khanh Pham (born 1978) is an American politician and activist currently serving as a member of the Oregon State Senate. A member of the Democratic Party, she represents the 23rd district, which consists of a portion of Southeast Portland, Northeast Portland, and the city of Maywood Park. She previously served in the Oregon House of Representatives from 2021 to 2025, representing the 46th district.
